sources.title: Blue Remembered Earth by Alastair Reynolds
sources.author: The Wertzone, January 2012
sources.access_method: Public indexed prosperity and surveillance discussion read
sources.read_scope: Economic development, AI crime intervention and differing coverage off Earth.
sources.limitations: Prosperity and automated policing do not establish that wages cease to be the main route to necessities or that AI owns production.

decisions.reason: Gentian wealth, longevity and advanced ships are clear, but the quick references do not establish a common labor-independent support arrangement.
decisions.analysis: The group also performs engineering and trade. An affluent clonal cohort cannot be admitted solely from the absence of visible subsistence labor.
decisions.follow_up: Skip deeper reading under the pace instruction; require a concrete automatic production/access reference before admission.

decisions.reason: The Machine People are an independent robot civilization, without an established human support population or justified post-work person-level economy.
decisions.analysis: Artificial personhood is not denied, but a robot civilization alone supplies neither an applicable human work fraction nor evidence that its people are free of necessary labor.
decisions.follow_up: Preserve as a machine-civilization comparison; skip further investigation.

decisions.reason: The Vigilance's unusual archivists and information exchange do not establish general production or labor-independent material access.
decisions.analysis: Archival work, immense bodies and longevity are capabilities and occupations rather than a verified post-work distribution mechanism.

decisions.reason: The broad far-future settlement lead combines distinct periods without clear general access rules in the short references.
decisions.analysis: Alien technology gifts, bargaining and a later human colony do not by themselves establish who receives necessities independently of work. The early mining crew and the framing Congress are separate scopes.
decisions.follow_up: Skip deeper reading; reopen only on a short, specific material-economy reference.

decisions.reason: The short sources establish a prosperous surveilled Earth, but not labor-independent household access or ownership of automated production.
decisions.analysis: AI intervention against crime is not sovereign AI control of the economy. A wealthy protagonist's family and eliminated poverty cannot alone establish the requested automation-distribution link across Earth and the United Aquatic Nations.
decisions.follow_up: Skip further reading in this pass; preserve the distinction between security automation and material provision.

review_notes: The user explicitly permits obscure economic leads to be skipped; no novel reading was used to rescue these five cases.
Long life, wealthy travelers, robot citizens, alien gifts and AI policing are not substituted for actual production/allocation arrangements.
Reader-review aggregation is identified as such and used for context only; no unsupported source is promoted into an admitted society record.
